attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3047/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The line enumerates both men by name, so there is a folder for each, and the two share one life. Neither is any of the corpus's Narses or Nerses folders: `narses-9-november` is kept on the Greek 9 November, `narses-companion-of-jonah` on 29 March and `nerses-the-martyr` on 15 June, and the Greek form here is Νιρσάς, not Ναρσής. The page gives no year — the persecution under Shapur II is named without one — so no `dates` object is proposed. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
